Leah (CS): Marco from AuroraEdge asks for APAC pin + temporary burst for an investor demo next Wed. Wants ap-southeast-1 primary, fallback ap-northeast-1, qps=350 for 3h window (2026-04-21 09:00-12:00 SGT), IPs 203.0.113.200/32 and 198.51.100.210/32, CORS https://demo.auroraedge.ai. Also request scoped demo key limited to model=v1.4 and retention=0. Can we provision and confirm by EOD?
Marco (AuroraEdge): Correct. Streaming will be on, ~40 concurrent streams. Token must expire 4h after window. Also prefer traffic isolation so attendees don't hit other tenants.
Eve (Eng Infra): We can create a region pin and isolated route pool for tenant=auroraedge. For 350 qps with streaming I'd reserve 3x g4dn and allow autoscale to 5. Will stage ACL entries now. Need signed demo AUP before prod ACL push.
Ravi (SRE): Reserving 3 nodes in ap-southeast-1, autoscale min=3 max=5, trigger p95>650ms for 2m. I'll add queue latency alerts and monitor. Staging ACL has the two IPs.
Samir (Security): We'll require a signed AUP + the one-page security addendum. Token will be scoped to the two CIDRs, model=v1.4, expires=2026-04-21T16:00:00Z, retention=0, and debug logging disabled. Recommend disabling request bodies in logs for that token.
Leah (CS): I'll send the AUP + addendum to Marco now. Marco, please sign and return by EOD so we can issue the token 24h before the demo. Sales flagged this account as "renewal opportunity" if demo performs well.
deploy-bot: Route creation requested: route-auroraedge-ap-southeast-1 queued at 4422334460 by Ravi (SRE)
Ravi (SRE): I'll monitor during the demo; alerts set for cpu>72%, p95 latency>700ms, error-rate>0.75%. If thresholds hit, I'll scale to max and notify here. Ping #eng-sre during the window for live ops.
Marco (AuroraEdge): Signing now. Appreciate the quick turnaround — will upload signed doc to the secure share and ping Leah.
Leah (CS): Thanks team  once doc's uploaded I'll confirm prod ACL push and hand over scoped demo key.
